survey.name: location_notice
label: **This form records your location** while it is open (KoboCollect). It is used to check where observations were made. Form version 2026111201.

survey.name: date
label: Date of observation
constraint_message: The date can't be in the future or more than 60 days ago.

hint: Its usual short name, e.g. WFP or MSF.
survey.name: org_other
label: Which organisation?

hint: The name people use for it.
survey.name: site_other
label: Site name

hint: A few words, e.g. school, church, playground.
survey.name: feature_type_other
label: What is it?

hint: Short and unique on this site, e.g. WP-03. Use the same ID when you come back to this point.
survey.name: feature_id
label: Feature ID
constraint_message: Keep the ID to 12 characters or fewer.

hint: e.g. 6 latrine cubicles, 20 tents, 2 water tanks. Leave empty if it can't be counted.
survey.name: count
label: How many units are at this point?

survey.name: status_access_note
label: For an access constraint or a hazard: Working = passable, Partly working = restricted, Not working = blocked.

hint: What you saw, e.g. 2 of 6 taps broken, flooded, locked.
survey.name: status_reason
label: What is wrong?

survey.name: wash_features
label: What does it have?
constraint_message: "None" can't be combined with other answers.

survey.name: wash_access
label: Who can use it safely?
constraint_message: "None" can't be combined with other answers.

survey.name: water_storage
label: Water storage
constraint_message: "None" can't be combined with other answers.

hint: All tanks at this point together. 1 m³ = 1,000 litres.
survey.name: water_storage_m3
label: Storage volume (m³)
constraint_message: Enter a number from 0 to 5000 m³.

survey.name: water_distribution_other
label: Specify how water is handed out

hint: All taps at this point, working or not.
survey.name: tap_count
label: Number of taps
constraint_message: Enter a number from 0 to 200 taps.

hint: Count similar shelters in this area in the count question above.
survey.name: shelter_type
label: Type of shelter

survey.name: shelter_capacity
label: How many people can one shelter hold?
constraint_message: Enter a number from 0 to 2000 people.

survey.name: observation_beds
label: Observation beds
constraint_message: Enter a number from 0 to 500 beds.

survey.name: inpatient_beds
label: Inpatient beds
constraint_message: Enter a number from 0 to 2000 beds.

survey.name: space_users_other
label: Specify who the space is for

survey.name: space_setting_other
label: Specify what the space is like

hint: Usable volume. A 10 × 24 m mobile storage unit is about 700 m³.
survey.name: storage_capacity_m3
label: Storage capacity (m³)
constraint_message: Enter a number from 0 to 50000 m³.

survey.name: road_hotspot_other
label: Specify what is on the road

hint: Which vehicles can pass, water depth, length, detour.
survey.name: access_description
label: Describe the constraint

survey.name: energy_uses
label: What is the power used for?

hint: Stand at the point and wait for the accuracy to drop below 10 m, or place the pin on the map.
survey.name: location
label: Location

survey.name: location_warning
label: GPS accuracy is ${location_accuracy} m. Wait for a better fix, or place the pin by hand and choose "Placed on the map" below.

label: Photo

hint: Avoid faces, children and people in vulnerable situations.

survey.name: note
label: Comments

hint: Instead of, or as well as, typing the comment.
survey.name: note_audio
label: Voice note (optional)

label: **Save and send this observation.** Then open a new form for the next point. The organisation, place and site carry over.
